identicalCasesNote: RANDOM_LEGAL, HEURISTIC_GREEDY_IMMEDIATE and NEXUS_RELATIONAL_SELECTOR_V1 run on the same VALIDATION sample. PRIME_FROZEN runs on a quarter of it because it regenerates and searches each world, and its sample size is reported alongside its numbers rather than being compared as if it were the same set.
nexusSelectorNote: NEXUS_RELATIONAL_SELECTOR_V1 is a deterministic policy BUILT ON deterministic Nexus, not Nexus itself. Nexus emits graph-level signals — bottleneck, critical-dependency, threatened and unsupported counts, depth, density — and no per-action output whatsoever. Ranking legal actions therefore needs a policy on top of those signals, and it is reported under its own name so no reader mistakes it for the certified expert. Nexus is unmodified.
